parsed.rationale: Both participating records reside under `Tests/` directory subtrees — `Shared/Playback/Tests/HLSPlayerTests/MockHLSAVPlayer.swift` and `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTestUtilities/Mocks/MockPlayer.swift` — and carry `Mock` prefixes in both their type names (`MockHLSAVPlayer`, `MockPlayer`) and file paths, marking them as deliberate test fixtures. Although the pipeline flags `is_mock: false` and `is_test: false`, the file-path and naming evidence is unambiguous: these are mock stand-ins for distinct collaborators (`HLSAVPlayer` vs. a generic `Player`), and their `play` implementations are independently contractual to their respective test suites. Additionally, `fields_or_signature` is empty for both records, so there is no grounded method-body evidence to support a safe extraction. Merging or lifting these mocks would couple two separate test contracts and risk masking divergence in future mock evolution.
